info.title: Personal Expense Tracker API
info.description: RESTful API for personal income, expenses, categories, and financial statistics.

post.summary: Authenticates a user and issues an access and refresh token pair.
Rotates a valid refresh token and revokes the previously issued refresh token.
Revokes the caller's presented refresh token idempotently.

get.summary: Returns the currently authenticated user's profile.

put.summary: Updates the signed-in user's full name.
Changes the caller's password and revokes all active refresh tokens.

get.summary: Lists all system categories and personal categories owned by the caller.

post.summary: Creates a new personal category for the authenticated caller.

get.summary: Returns a single system or caller-owned personal category.

put.summary: Updates a personal category owned by the caller.

delete.summary: Deletes an unused personal category owned by the caller.

get.summary: Returns income, expense, balance, and transaction count for a month, year, or all time.
Returns zero-filled daily statistics over an inclusive range up to 366 days.
Returns zero-filled 12-month statistics for a calendar year.
Returns zero-filled yearly statistics across up to 20 years.
Returns per-category totals and percentage shares for a transaction type and optional date range.
Returns the top N categories while preserving each category's percentage share of the full period total.
Compares income, expense, and balance between two months with percentage deltas.
Lists the caller's transactions with optional filtering, searching, sorting, and paging.

post.summary: Creates a new transaction for the caller.

get.summary: Returns a single transaction owned by the caller.

put.summary: Replaces an existing transaction owned by the caller.

delete.summary: Deletes a transaction owned by the caller.

AuthResponse.description: Authentication response containing short-lived JWT access token, rotating refresh token, and caller profile.

CategoryDto.description: Public representation of a system or personal category (never exposes owner `UserId`).

CategoryStatDto.description: Aggregated category total, transaction count, and percentage share of the period total for the type.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Request payload for changing the caller's password.

CreateCategoryRequest.description: Request payload for creating a personal income or expense category.

CreateTransactionRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new income or expense transaction.

DailyStatDto.description: Daily income, expense, and net totals for a single calendar date.

LoginRequest.description: Credentials submitted to authenticate and receive an access/refresh token pair.

MonthComparisonDto.description: Comparison between a target month and a baseline month, with absolute and percentage changes.

MonthlyStatDto.description: Monthly income, expense, and balance totals for a given calendar month.

PagedResultOfTransactionDto.description: Standard paged response container for list endpoints.

PeriodTotalsDto.description: Totals for a single calendar year and month used in period comparisons.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Request payload containing the opaque refresh token to rotate or revoke.

RegisterRequest.description: Request payload for registering a new user account.

SummaryDto.description: Income, expense, net balance, and transaction count over an optional date range.

TransactionDto.description: Public representation of a user's income or expense transaction.

TransactionType.description:
Classifies a transaction or category as income or expense.
Explicit numbering starts at 1 so default value 0 can never pass silently as a valid enum.

UpdateCategoryRequest.description: Request payload for full-replacing a personal category's name and type.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Request payload for updating the signed-in user's display name.

UpdateTransactionRequest.description: Request payload for full replacement of an existing transaction via PUT.

UserDto.description: Public representation of an authenticated user (never includes password hashes).

YearlyStatDto.description: Yearly income, expense, and balance totals for a given calendar year.

Bearer.description: Enter the JWT access token issued by /api/auth/login or /api/auth/refresh-token.
